notProjected.pOperations: Borrowed counted POD array; no implicit raw pointer exposure. NativeSequence currently requires distinct data/count output slots.

xui_doc_attributes_t.input: setAttributesColumns packs 13 scalar fields and nullable language; replaces the complete attributes value.

notProjected.sFontFamily: Fixed char[64] is zeroed by this basic pack. Use range setTextStyle with a real DocumentTextStyle POD for a font family.

xui_doc_node_desc_t.input: insertNode packs kind, counted text, resource/info/title/link fields; Native copies them before return.

notProjected.tAttributes: Zero-initialized default attributes; adjust the inserted node with transaction methods.
notProjected.pExtensionPayload: Use setExtensionPayload with checked bytes; no opaque pointer field.

xui_doc_image_desc_t.input: insertImage/updateImage pack all public fields with counted alt text and nullable NUL strings.

xui_doc_source_index_desc_t.input: createSourceIndex packs default allocator settings and maxWorkingBytes.

notProjected.onCancel: Callback nested inside a packed descriptor is not synthesized as a persistent raw callback.

xui_doc_desc_t.input: Owned constructors pack size and all eight ordinary settings.

notProjected.onAlloc: Custom allocator callback lifetime is C-only.
notProjected.onFree: Must be paired with allocator, outlives all handles.

notProjected.iSize: Per-element sizeof initialization needs a checked array-record field contract.
notProjected.sText: Per-element counted string lifetime/byte length cannot be replaced by NUL scanning.
notProjected.iTextBytes: Must be paired with its actual element text source.

costs.descriptorPacks: Stack initialization and field assignments; counted inputs are pinned; NUL strings require validation/scans.
costs.owningRoots: One resident control/code lease and real native owner per independent root; share/factories reserve before producer.
costs.POD: Exact native values or stack output-record field copies; no arbitrary pointer projection.
costs.buffers: Scope/pin/length checks; Native Copy performs its documented bytes copy; lengths remain unchanged.
costs.callbacks: Native Owned capture ownership plus checked epoch admission; explicit share acquires a real separate owner.
costs.ownedExports: Text adopts the actual resident-XRT allocation after one UTF-8 scan; bytes adds its ordinary owning value carrier. No payload copy or strlen.
